label: GO after an unrewarded trial (mostly one that reached S2), early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at GO steps, and only when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward == 0 holds for 100% of activations; it never fires after a reward, and never at D1 or D2). It is also limited to early in the episode: the firing rate is highest on trials 1-9 (5-12x lift), falls off through trials 20-39, and is essentially zero after trial 50. Among those steps it prefers cases where the unrewarded previous trial reached S2 (prev_state == 2; prev_state -1 means the previous trial is outside the window). It also fires more when the agent is about to switch (stay == 0, 3.8x), but adding that cuts recall too much. Every condition is observed at GO; no future variables are used. Dev scores: precision 0.44, recall 0.91, mass recall 0.96, F1 0.59. With ep_trial < 25, F1 is 0.62 but mass recall drops to 0.92. Precision is still incomplete: many early unrewarded-S2 GO steps stay silent, and activations are tiny in absolute terms (max 0.003). The strongest activations come right after an unrewarded trial, often two in a row, in the first ~10 trials. That is a rate observation; magnitude was not checked separately.
